errors.evidence: The chart displays a blue area chart, not a blue bar chart (стълбовидна графика).
The growth rate of 10% corresponds to the year 2018, not 2017. There is no growth rate value shown for 2017.
The growth rate decreases from 10% in 2018 to 9% in 2019. The description incorrectly states that it increases ("нараства").

errors.evidence: The orange line representing growth does not gradually rise. It fluctuates, decreasing from 2018 to 2019 and again from 2021 to 2023.
The description does not mention the legend, which is present at the bottom of the chart and explains the two data series ("В2В пазар" and "Ръст").
